query: I'm designing "Kustomize Exec Secret Generator" in kubernetes/enhancements and I'm considering using "Enable Plugins with Environment Variables". Was that approach already considered on this project, and if so, why wasn't it adopted?
response:
Yes, the approach to **"Enable Plugins with Environment Variables"** (allowing users to set `export KUSTOMIZE_ENABLE_PLUGINS=true` instead of passing a command-line flag) was considered. 

It was not adopted because:
* Since an environment variable could be set persistently in the environment, it **"doesn't provide much additional security over the plugin directories."** 

Instead, the proposal requires plugins to be explicitly enabled via a command-line flag (e.g., `--enable-kust-plugins`) to ensure safeguards against executing arbitrary commands from untrusted/malicious `kustomization.yaml` files (a security concern detailed in [kubernetes-sigs/kustomize#692](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kustomize/issues/692)).
